title: Configuration sigma (protocol.md section 4; subject-neutral since protocol v3)
description: Constructor-reachable configuration: deploy the subject's contract (or Spec over it) with ctor from deployer, run setup (the subject's profile setup, sent by the deployer, verbatim; present iff the subject has a setup), run txs in order, then optionally the probe. Names are pool names, values decimal strings. Not expressible here and enforced by specgame_core.validate_sigma against the subject's profile: the pools (deployer and senders in profile.senders, address/bytes32 names in the pools), the argument types of each fn (address/bytes32 -> pool name, uint256 -> unsigned decimal <= 2^256-1, int256 -> signed decimal in range), the ctor keys = profile.constructor.params, the probe keys = sender + every probe signature's parameter names, setup = profile.setup with sender = deployer, fn in the artifact ABI.

setup.description: The subject's setup, verbatim: part of the canonical form and hash, replayed by the verifier.

check.description: Provenance only: the check the adversary targeted. Scoring calls every check_* of the spec.
